content:
Maya: Need quick deal-desk OK. Customer: Meridian Health Tech wants a 12% pilot discount for a 4-month evaluation and wants partner commission maintained at 7% (partner proposed higher co-sell fee). Sales proposes discount limited to pilot SKU, no renewal carry, and a $10,000 maximum concession.

Owen: Context: competitor offered 15% and free integration hours. Customer is strategic for our healthcare connectors roadmap. If we don't match, they likely go competitor.

Diego: Impact sketch: ```
Annualized ARR if converted: $48,000
4mo rev @ list: $16,000
4mo @ 12% off: $14,080 (delta = -$1,920)
Max concession cap: $10,000 protects downside
```
Agree with pilot-only clause.

LegalBot: We need a short amendment labeled "pilot promotional concession" with: non-renewal carryover clause, credit cap, partner acknowledgment about commission, and a data-protection addendum for healthcare data. Can draft redlines if Sales uploads SOW.

FinanceBot: Policy: discounts >10% require Finance Manager + RevOps approval and a completed deal-desk form. Please attach deal impact and the signed partner acknowledgment. Link: https://intranet.redwood/finance/deal-desk-policy (internal).

Maya: @Owen please upload SOW + partner acknowledgement + completed deal-desk form by 2505000300. If Legal flags any new risks I'll hold.

Owen: Will upload by 2505000250 and add CRM note with tag "pilot-strategic-healthcare". Marking thread deal-desk:pending. :thumbsup:

Maya: Thanks — will route to Finance Manager after uploads.
